acceptance: A test runs RF1 and RF2 on a small database, then shows the next run recreates it.
The 18 bundles without per-table rows are listed with whether any other evidence shows they ran on a fresh database.
context: Remaining limit recorded at closeout of stale-shared-output-dir-tpch-q18-mismatch-20261114. Guardrails: linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight), never the primary clone; one PR per repo; no live-cloud runs or credentials in Git or logs; heavy work only via lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run after make heavy-status; never start deliberate host load; comment policy; changelog.d fragment for user-facing change. Re-verify every cited file and line before acting; they are hints.
description:
Problem: PR #4273 made database reuse require exact counts for orders and the small tables and lineitem within 0.5%. A database that completed an RF1+RF2 pair keeps the orders count, so only lineitem's 0.5% band can catch it, which is loose at SF 1 and above; refreshed rows change data, not counts. 18 published TPC-H-family bundles record no per-table rows, so the corpus scan could not check them.

Outcome: a reused database records whether refresh functions ran against it, and reuse refuses or recreates a refreshed database regardless of counts.
